## Schedule missing next activities for open Pipedrive deals with Slack escalation

For sales and partnership teams who want one rule enforced in Pipedrive: no open deal without a next activity.

**Built for:** Trialbridge, clinical-trial recruitment, physician referral network — workflow 1 of 2. The job: https://example.com/jobs/~022093811915701331307/

### How it works
1. Every weekday it reads all open deals and activities, page by page. A failed or cut-short read raises an alert and fails the run instead of passing as a clean day.
2. Fields named like patient or medical data are blocked before anything is read.
3. A deal counts as covered only by an open activity due within `HORIZON_DAYS`.
4. Uncovered deals get the activity their stage calls for, due in business days and moved to a lighter day when the rep is already full.
5. Overdue deals never get a second task: 3 business days late goes to the rep, 7 to the manager, who hears about each deal once plus a reminder if it stays open.
6. A team summary with the coverage trend, a manager escalation and one Slack DM per rep are sent.

### Setup
1. Run it as imported: a demo pipeline runs end to end and nothing is written.
2. In `config` set `COMPANY_DOMAIN`, `API_TOKEN` and the stage map.
3. Add Slack webhook URLs; for rep DMs add a Slack credential, `SLACK_DMS` and `OWNER_SLACK_IDS`.
4. Set `TEST_OWNER_ID` to test on one user, then `TEST_RUN = false` to go live.

### Requirements
A Pipedrive API token. Slack is optional; a blank setting skips that branch.

### How to customize
Stage rules, escalation tiers, `HOLIDAYS`, `MAX_PER_OWNER_PER_DAY` and `DAILY_CAP` are all in `config`.

## 1. Start and settings
Weekday schedule or the Run button. Every setting lives in `config`; no token means the demo pipeline.

## 2. Read every page
Open deals and activities, 500 a page until Pipedrive says there is no more. A partial read counts as a failed read.

## 3. If the read fails
Alert with the call that failed, then fail the execution. A broken token never looks like a clean pipeline.

## 4. Check compliance and coverage
Medical-looking fields are blocked first. Covered means an open activity due inside the horizon; overdue is counted in business days.

## 5. Decide and create
Stage rule, business-day due date, moved to a lighter day if the rep is full. Overdue deals escalate instead. Preview creates nothing.

## 6. Remember
Coverage trend and who the manager was already told, kept in workflow static data.

## 7. Tell the team, the manager and each rep
Team summary, manager escalation (new or reminder only) and one Slack DM per rep. Blank settings skip a branch.

nodes.name: [cred] Pipedrive - open deals
nodes.notes: Pipedrive v1 GET /deals, every page: start = additional_data.pagination.next_start until more_items_in_collection is false, at most MAX_PAGES pages. One item per page.

nodes.name: [cred] Pipedrive - activities
nodes.notes: user_id=0 means every user. Execute Once: the deals node hands over one item per page, and this read must happen once, not once per page.

nodes.name: [cred] Pipedrive - deal fields
nodes.notes: Field NAMES, which is what the PHI check reads. A custom field's 40-character key says nothing about what is in it.

nodes.name: Post the read-failure alert
nodes.notes: ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL, or MANAGER_WEBHOOK_URL if that is the only one set.

nodes.name: STOP: fail the run on a bad read
check every deal for a next activity
STOP: every open deal is covered
[cred] Pipedrive - create the next activity
nodes.notes: Pipedrive v1 POST /activities. The body — business-day, load-levelled due date included — is built in 'decide the next activity' so it is readable without opening this node.

nodes.name: Post the run summary
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook shape. Any endpoint that accepts JSON works.

nodes.name: Post the management escalation
nodes.notes: MANAGER_WEBHOOK_URL if set, otherwise ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL. New and reminder deals only.

nodes.name: [cred] Slack - DM each owner
nodes.notes: Slack chat.postMessage with a member id as the channel opens the bot DM with that rep. Bot scope: chat:write.
